newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius to launch 600 mln rupee Port Louis Fund.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius to launch 600 mln rupee Port Louis Fund.

text.p: Mauritius Finance Minister Vasant Bunwaree said on Saturday the government had decided to raise 600 million rupees by setting up the Port Louis Fund.
The fund was initially to consist of 1.2 billion rupees in issued share capital but the cabinet on Friday backed Bunwaree's proposal for the fund to start with only 600 million.
Bunwaree told reporters Mauritius Telecoms would not be immediately be involved in the fund but within six months it could sell a maximum of 200 million rupees to the fund.
Bunwaree said Telecoms involvement in the fund was being delayed because two international firms were valuing its shares to take into account capital projects and alliances with other companies.
He said in the meantime 500 million rupees of Mauritius Telecoms shares would be sold to the National Pension Fund.
The Port Louis Fund will be listed on the Stock Exchange of Mauritius and prospectuses would be issued by the end of May.
The PLF consist of listed companies and securities and unlisted companies and will be the island's second country fund following the launch of Mauritius Fund in 1992. ($1= 20.4 Mauritian rupees)
